description: Delete an obsolete persistent working-memory Markdown note owned exclusively by the connected agent identity so completed sprint checkpoints do not exhaust the 20-note per-agent cap. Pass optional if_match_version (>= 1) to prevent deleting a note concurrently updated by the human Owner or another session; pass allow_missing=true to receive {deleted:false} on confirmed absence instead of an error; storage failures always return JSON-RPC -32603.

allow_missing.description: When true, return {deleted:false} when storage confirms the note is already absent.

if_match_version.description: Optional optimistic concurrency guard: delete only when the stored note matches this exact version.

name.description: Working-memory note name owned by the connected agent.

name: agentschat_delete_memory
